heroes.tagline: The Radiant Guardian of Metro Nova
heroes.backstory: Infused with the solar heart of an interstellar flare during an orbital research mission, Marcus returned to Earth as a beacon of unstoppable solar radiance.

heroes.tagline: The Silent Justice in the Dark
heroes.backstory: Heir to the Vance Industrial empire, Cassandra trained in martial mastery across six continents to avenge her father and dismantle corruption from the shadows.
Born with dense hyper-cellular muscle fibers and bone density harder than diamond, Derrick works as an EMT, saving lives both with defibrillators and sheer muscle.

heroes.tagline: The Digital Storm over the Skyline
heroes.job: Tech Columnist at The Daily Chronicle
heroes.backstory: A prodigal cyberneticist who built her own powered exosuit with micro-missile arrays and cyber-disruption dampeners after her university lab was raided by cyber-terrorists.
An antique scholar who unlocked the forbidden Grimoire of Aethelgard, gaining the power to bend eldritch dimensions and ward the mortal plane from cosmic horrors.

villains.name: Null Void
villains.motive: Devour Metro Nova in a miniature black hole singularity.
villains.backstory: Former particle physicist consumed by dark matter during an antimatter collider disaster. Believes the universe must return to peaceful absolute nothingness.
quips: Your light is merely a brief spark before eternal darkness!
All atoms will bow before the void!
You cannot punch an event horizon, hero!

villains.name: Queen Pyre
villains.motive: Extort the city government by threatening to ignite the subterranean fuel reserves.
villains.backstory: A pyromancer who leads the Inferno Syndicate, ruling the underground black market with an iron and fiery fist.
quips: Is it getting warm in here, or is that just your impending defeat?
Metro Nova was built to burn!
Bow before the queen of flames!

villains.name: Cyber-Gorgon
villains.motive: Infect the city's central AI grid and convert citizens into augmented drones.
villains.backstory: An outcast cybernetics researcher who replaced her organic nervous system with a self-evolving neural network and venomous micro-drones.
quips: Flesh is weak. Logic is eternal.
Analyzing attack vector... probability of your survival: 0.04%.

villains.name: Iron Juggernaut
villains.motive: Rob the Federal Depository and crush any cape who dares stand in his path.
villains.backstory: A disgraced mercenary clad in heavy hydraulic power-armor, specialized in high-risk armored bank heists and demolitions.
quips: You're like a fly on my reinforced titanium plating!
Time to smash some superhero skulls!

villains.name: Madame Mirage
villains.motive: Steal the Astral Diamond and frame the city's superhero league for the crime.
villains.backstory: A master psionic illusionist and international jewel thief who manipulates memories and bends sensory reality to execute impossible heists.
quips: Are you sure what you are seeing is real?
A hero blinded by their own self-righteous illusions.

villains.name: Chronos Master
villains.motive: Rewind Metro Nova to 1920 to rule it as an immortal temporal monarch.
villains.backstory: A mad temporal physicist who created a localized tachyon time-distortion harness to manipulate entropy and conquer all timelines.
quips: I have already seen every move you will ever make.
Your defeat was written three minutes ago in my ledger.

sidekicks.backstory: An eager high-school prodigy with natural electro-kinetic speed. Loyal, fast-talking, and eager to learn.
A teenage robotics genius who built reconnaissance drones to patrol alleyways in the Neon District.
A disciplined dojo prodigy with immense physical fortitude, determined to clear his family name.
An arcane novice gifted with rare healing sigils and shielding leylines.

relationships.name: Kit "Spark" Morales
relationships.backstory: An eager teenage electro-kinetic speedster you took under your wing after saving his neighborhood.
relationships.perk: Can be summoned to assist in combat, providing an extra attack each round.

relationships.name: Chloe Rivera
relationships.backstory: Your childhood best friend and local coffee shop owner who provides emotional support and grounds you in normal life.
relationships.perk: Spending time together reduces Hero Stress by 50% and reduces Identity Suspicion by 15%.

relationships.name: Liam Vance
relationships.backstory: A cynical Pulitzer-winning investigative journalist constantly digging into your civilian alibis.
relationships.perk: Feeding exclusive scoops boosts Comic Issue sales by 30% and keeps media favor high.

relationships.name: Captain Elena Ramirez
relationships.backstory: A tough, honest precinct commander who secretly cooperates with capes to bypass corrupt bureaucracy.
relationships.perk: Provides prioritized dispatch intel, revealing Masterplan Clues 50% faster during patrols.

relationships.name: Dr. Sarah Sterling
relationships.backstory: Chief ER Trauma Surgeon at Metro General who repeatedly stitches up injured vigilantes and civilians alike.
relationships.perk: Provides free emergency medical supplies, auto-healing 30% HP after difficult combats.

mayoral_candidates.name: Thomas Sterling
mayoral_candidates.title: Former District Judge & Civic Philanthropist
mayoral_candidates.campaignQuote: Our heroes are the shield that guards our future. City Hall should stand with them, not against them!

mayoral_candidates.name: Victor Vance Sr.
mayoral_candidates.title: Ex-Commissioner of Municipal Police
mayoral_candidates.platform: Zero Tolerance Law & Order & Anti-Vigilante Sanctions
mayoral_candidates.campaignQuote: Unaccountable masked vigilantes cannot replace the rule of law. Order must be restored by badge and law!

mayoral_candidates.name: Evelyn Cross-Sterling
mayoral_candidates.title: CEO of Apex Global Technologies
mayoral_candidates.campaignQuote: Through innovation, automated defense grids, and corporate prosperity, Metro Nova will lead the world.

alliances.name: The Apex Vanguard
alliances.motto: By Vigilance, We Illuminate the Horizon.

alliances.name: Street Knights Coalition
alliances.motto: No Shadow Darker Than Our Resolve.

multiverse_boss_variants.title: Tyrant Solar Imperator
multiverse_boss_variants.dialogue: Order requires absolute rule! This timeline shall kneel as mine did!

multiverse_boss_variants.title: Arch-Purifier of the Nether-Rift
multiverse_boss_variants.dialogue: All dimensions must be cleansed in the purifying dark flame of the void!

multiverse_boss_variants.title: Infinite Master of Brass Entropy
multiverse_boss_variants.dialogue: Tick-tock, anomaly. Your existence is mathematically overdue for deletion.
